test_cases.Test Description: Verifies reset values and masked read/write behavior over the 32 per-pin GPIO registers (GPIO_8–GPIO_39), the raw interrupt status/clear register (GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1), interrupt enable/status registers (INTR1_INTR_EN1, INTR1_INTR_STS1, INTR2_INTR_EN1, INTR2_INTR_STS1), group IO control (GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP1–GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP4), group output data (GPIO_DOUT_GROUP1–GPIO_DOUT_GROUP4), and group input data (GPIO_DIN_GROUP1–GPIO_DIN_GROUP4) via 32‑bit CSR accesses; test passes only if no default-value or read‑back mismatches are observed.
test_cases.Remarks: VRRW-type registers are skipped for write/read testing. Default-value checks avoid group input data registers due to input behavior; reading group DIN without forcing inputs can result in unintended logic levels. These constraints are intentionally applied via skip controls.
test_cases.Test Steps / Procedure:
Entry: Begin at the defined test entry, then perform default-value verification followed by masked write/read verification, and finally evaluate overall pass/fail.
Default-value verification (reset checks):
1) For each addressed register in {GPIO_8–GPIO_39, GPIO_INTR_RAW_STCLR1, INTR1_INTR_EN1, INTR1_INTR_STS1, INTR2_INTR_EN1, INTR2_INTR_STS1, GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP1–GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP4, GPIO_DOUT_GROUP1–GPIO_DOUT_GROUP4, GPIO_DIN_GROUP1–GPIO_DIN_GROUP4} in index order:
   a) If the register is marked to be skipped for reset checking, continue to the next.
   b) If the register is marked not readable, continue to the next.
   c) READ the register.
   d) Apply a mask that clears bit0 of the read value.
   e) Compare against the expected reset value for that register.
   f) If mismatch, record one reset‑mismatch failure; otherwise continue.
Masked write/read verification:
2) For each of six test patterns in order: 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xAAAAAAAA, 0x55555555, 0xF5F5F5F5, 0xA5A5A5A5, 0xFFFF0000:
   Write phase:
   2.1) For each addressed register (same ordered set as above):
        a) If the register is marked to be skipped for write/read, continue to the next.
        b) If the register is marked not writable, continue to the next.
        c) WRITE the pattern masked by the register’s write mask.
   Read/verify phase:
   2.2) For each addressed register (same ordered set as above):
        a) If the register is marked to be skipped for write/read, continue to the next.
        b) If the register is marked not writable, continue to the next.
        c) If the register is marked not readable, continue to the next.
        d) READ the register and apply the register’s read mask to the readback value.
        e) Form the expected value as: (pattern AND read mask AND write mask) OR ((NOT write mask) AND read mask AND the register’s default value).
        f) Compare readback vs. expected; on mismatch record one write/read failure; otherwise continue.
Completion:
3) If any reset-mismatch or write/read-mismatch failures were recorded, the test reports failure; otherwise it reports pass.
Timing:
- No active delays or waits are executed in this test.

test_cases.Validation / Acceptance Criteria: Pass: No mismatches are detected during reset-value checks and masked write/read checks across all addressed registers. Fail: Any mismatch observed in either phase.
test_cases.Hidden_Test_Description: Test performs two phases: (1) DEFAULT VALUE_CHECK via chk_rst_val(): iterates i=0..CNT-1, addr=addr_array[i]; if skip_rst_array[i]==1 continue; if read_mask_array[i]==0x00000000 continue; data_rd=read_reg(addr); data=(data_rd & 0xfffffffe); compares data == default_value_array[i], increments def_fail_cnt on mismatch. (2) WRITE & READ CHECK via chk_rd_wr(): for j=0..5 with chk_val={0xffffffff,0xaaaaaaaa,0x55555555,0xf5f5f5f5,0xA5A5A5A5,0xffff0000}; write phase loops i=0..CNT-1, addr=addr_array[i]; if skip_array[i]==1 continue; if write_mask_array[i]==0x00000000 continue; write_reg(addr,(data_wr & write_mask_array[i])); read/verify phase loops i=0..CNT-1, with skip and mask checks; data_rd=(read_reg(addr) & read_mask_array[i]); wr_n=(write_mask_array[i] ^ 0xffffffff); exp_val=((data_wr & read_mask_array[i] & write_mask_array[i]) | (wr_n & read_mask_array[i] & default_value_array[i])); compare data_rd==exp_val; on mismatch increment wr_fail_cnt. At end, if(def_fail_cnt>0 || wr_fail_cnt>0) finish(1); else finish(0).
test_cases.Hidden_Remarks: Comment notes: "SKIPPING VRRW registers" via skip_array[] indices; and: "when reading default values the din value is becoming 1 automatically if we don't force any value, but if we force zero to din bit level sel becoming high, so that reading value not matched with expected value". Therefore default-value checks skip group DIN registers using skip_rst_array[].
